verses.sloka: तम् उक्तवंतम् वैदेहम् विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ।उवाच वचनम् वीरम् वसिष्ठ सहितो नृपम् ॥१-७२-१॥
verses.transliteration: tam uktavaṁtam vaideham viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ।uvāca vacanam vīram vasiṣṭha sahito nṛpam ॥1-72-1॥

translations.english: When Janaka the valiant king of Videha thus spoke (on the genealogy of his family) the mighty ascetic Viswamitra accompanied by Vasishta said to Janaka:
translations.hindi: बालकाण्ड का बावनवाँ सगे समाप्त हुआ । नल 0 C सप्तषष्टितमः सगः Se नन जनकस्य वचः श्रृत्वा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः । घनुदेशय रामाय इति होवाच पार्थिवम्‌

verses.sloka: अचिंत्यानि अप्रमेयाणि कुलानि नरपुंगव ।इक्ष्वाकूणाम् विदेहानाम् न एषाम् तुल्यो अस्ति कश्चन ॥१-७२-२॥
verses.transliteration: aciṁtyāni aprameyāṇi kulāni narapuṁgava ।ikṣvākūṇām videhānām na eṣām tulyo asti kaścana ॥1-72-2॥

translations.english: "O Preeminent among men the glory of the two races of Ikshvakus as also of Videhas is in comprehensible and immeasurable. There is none equal to these kings of the Ikshvakus and Videhas.
translations.hindi: तब राजा जनक ने अपने मंत्रियों को आज्ञा दी कि, जो दिव्य धनुष चन्दन और पुष्पमालाओं से भूषित है, उसे ले एओ

verses.sloka: सदृशो धर्म संबन्धः सदृशो रूप संपदा ।राम लक्ष्मणयो राजन् सीता च ऊर्मिलया सह ॥१-७२-३॥
verses.transliteration: sadṛśo dharma saṁbandhaḥ sadṛśo rūpa saṁpadā ।rāma lakṣmaṇayo rājan sītā ca ūrmilayā saha ॥1-72-3॥

translations.english: O King it is a perfect match between Sita and Rama and Urmila and Lakshmana. In respect of piety and beauty the match is perfect.
translations.hindi: राजा जनक की आज्ञा पाकर मंत्री लोग मिथिलापुरी में गए ( यज्ञशाला नगरी के बाहर बनी थी) और उस धनुष को आगे कर चले

verses.sloka: वक्तव्यम् च नर श्रेष्ठ श्रूयताम् वचनम् मम ।भ्राता यवीयान् धर्मज्ञ एष राजा कुशध्वजः ॥१-७२-४॥
verses.transliteration: vaktavyam ca nara śreṣṭha śrūyatām vacanam mama ।bhrātā yavīyān dharmajña eṣa rājā kuśadhvajaḥ ॥1-72-4॥

translations.english: O Best of men my words deserve to be heard. This younger brother king Kusadhwaja is knower of righteousness.

verses.sloka: अस्य धर्मात्मनो राजन् रूपेण अप्रतिमम् भुवि ।सुता द्वयम् नरश्रेष्ठ पत्नि अर्थम् वरयामहे ॥१-७२-५॥
verses.transliteration: asya dharmātmano rājan rūpeṇa apratimam bhuvi ।sutā dvayam naraśreṣṭha patni artham varayāmahe ॥1-72-5॥

translations.english: O King, O Eminent among men we seek the hands of this virtuous king's two daughters, unrivalled in beauty, on earth, as consorts.
translations.hindi: हे ब्रह्मन्‌ ! यह श्रेष्ठ धनुष वही है, जिसका पूजन सक निमिबंशीय राजा करते चले आते हैँ । यह वही धनुष है जिस पर बड़े-बड़े पराक्रमी राजा लोग रोदा नहीं चढ़ा सके

verses.sloka: भरतस्य कुमारस्य शत्रुघ्नस्य च धीमतः ।वरयेम सुते राजन् तयोः अर्थे महात्मनोः ॥१-७२-६॥
verses.transliteration: bharatasya kumārasya śatrughnasya ca dhīmataḥ ।varayema sute rājan tayoḥ arthe mahātmanoḥ ॥1-72-6॥

translations.english: O king we choose your brother's daughters for the great souls: the young Bharata and the sagacious Satrughna.
translations.hindi: जिल पेटो में धनुष रखा था वह लोहे की थी--उसे ला कर, मंत्रियों ने सुरोपम महाराज जनक को इस बात की सूचना दी ॥%॥ इदं धनुवरं राजन्‌ पूजितं सर्वराजभिः । मिथिलाधिप राजेन्द्र दशेयेनं यदीच्छसि

verses.sloka: पुत्रा दशरथस्य इमे रूप यौवन शालिनः ।लोक पाल समाः सर्वे देव तुल्य पराक्रमाः ॥१-७२-७॥
verses.transliteration: putrā daśarathasya ime rūpa yauvana śālinaḥ ।loka pāla samāḥ sarve deva tulya parākramāḥ ॥1-72-7॥

translations.english: Bestowed with youth and beauty, these sons of Dasaratha resemble kings in defending the worlds and gods in valour.
translations.hindi: मंत्रियों की बात सुन, राजा ने हाथ जोड़ कर, महात्मा विश्वा- मित्र और राम-लक्ष्मण से कहा

verses.sloka: उभयोः अपि राजेन्द्र संबन्धेन अनुबध्यताम् ।इक्ष्वाकु कुलम् अव्यग्रम् भवतः पुण्य कर्मणः ॥१-७२-८॥
verses.transliteration: ubhayoḥ api rājendra saṁbandhena anubadhyatām ।ikṣvāku kulam avyagram bhavataḥ puṇya karmaṇaḥ ॥1-72-8॥

translations.english: O King of kings (Janaka) the bond between your race with its pious deeds and the Ikshvakus may be strenghthened by this alliance".

verses.sloka: विश्वामित्र वचः श्रुत्वा वसिष्ठस्य मते तदा ।जनकः प्रांजलिः वाक्यम् उवाच मुनिपुंगवौ ॥१-७२-९॥
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitra vacaḥ śrutvā vasiṣṭhasya mate tadā ।janakaḥ prāṁjaliḥ vākyam uvāca munipuṁgavau ॥1-72-9॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of Viswamitra which echoed the wish of Vasishta, Janaka replied to the eminent ascetics with folded palms.

verses.sloka: कुलम् धन्यम् इदम् मन्ये येषाम् तौ मुनिपुंगवौ ।सदृशम् कुल संबन्धम् यत् आज्ञापयथः स्वयम् ॥१-७२-१०॥
verses.transliteration: kulam dhanyam idam manye yeṣām tau munipuṁgavau ।sadṛśam kula saṁbandham yat ājñāpayathaḥ svayam ॥1-72-10॥

translations.english: "Since both of you, eminent ascetics, recomended this befitting alliance of the two races on your own, I regard my race as blessed.
translations.hindi: उसके टूटने का शब्द बज्रपात के समान हुआ । बड़े जोर से भूमि हिल गयी और बड़े-बड़े पहाड़ फट गए

verses.sloka: एवम् भवतु भद्रम् वः कुशध्वज सुते इमे ।पत्न्यौ भजेताम् सहितौ शत्रुघ्न भरतौ उभौ ॥१-७२-११॥
verses.transliteration: evam bhavatu bhadram vaḥ kuśadhvaja sute ime ।patnyau bhajetām sahitau śatrughna bharatau ubhau ॥1-72-11॥

translations.english: "Let it be so, Be blessed Let these two daughters of Kusadhwaja (Srutakirti and Mandavi) be the wives of Satrughna and Bharata respectively and serve them.
translations.hindi: हे ऋषिश्रेष्ठ ! वह श्रेष्ठ धनुष आ गया है। हे महाभाग ! छसे इन राजकुमारों को दिखलाइए

verses.sloka: एक अह्ना राज पुत्रीणाम् चतसॄणाम् महामुने ।पाणीन् गृह्णन्तु चत्वारो राज पुत्रा महाबलाः ॥१-७२-१२॥
verses.transliteration: eka ahnā rāja putrīṇām catasṝṇām mahāmune ।pāṇīn gṛhṇantu catvāro rāja putrā mahābalāḥ ॥1-72-12॥

translations.english: O Great ascetic let the valiant four princes take the hands of four princesses on the same day.
translations.hindi: धर्मात्मा जिश्वामित्र जी ने जब राजा जनक के ये बचन सुने, तब उन्होने श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से कहा--हे वत्स ! इस धनुष को देखो

verses.sloka: उत्तरे दिवसे ब्रह्मन् फल्गुनीभ्याम् मनीषिणः ।वैवाहिकम् प्रशंसन्ति भगो यत्र प्रजापतिः ॥१-७२-१३॥
verses.transliteration: uttare divase brahman phalgunībhyām manīṣiṇaḥ ।vaivāhikam praśaṁsanti bhago yatra prajāpatiḥ ॥1-72-13॥

translations.english: "The wise, O Brahmin think the marriage is favourable when Bhaga is Prajapati on the succeeding day of the ascent of the two stars. (that is, when poorva is followed by uttara phalguni).
translations.hindi: महर्षि के ये वचन सुन, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी वहाँ गए जहाँ धनुष ` था और उस पेटी को, जिसमें वह धनुष था, खोल कर, धनुष देखा और बोले

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा वचः सौम्यम् प्रत्युत्थाय कृतांजलिः ।उभौ मुनि वरौ राजा जनको वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-७२-१४॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā vacaḥ saumyam pratyutthāya kṛtāṁjaliḥ ।ubhau muni varau rājā janako vākyam abravīt ॥1-72-14॥

translations.english: King Janaka, having spoken these pleasing words, stood up and with folded hands addressing both the great ascetics:
translations.hindi: हे ब्रह्मन्‌ ! अब इस धनुष को में हाथ लगाता हुँ और इसे उठा कर इस पर रोदा चढ़ाने का प्रयत्न करता हूँ

verses.sloka: परो धर्मः कृतो मह्यम् शिष्यो अस्मि भवतोः सदा ।इमानि आसन मुख्यानि आस्यताम् मुनिपुंगवौ ॥१-७२-१५॥
verses.transliteration: paro dharmaḥ kṛto mahyam śiṣyo asmi bhavatoḥ sadā ।imāni āsana mukhyāni āsyatām munipuṁgavau ॥1-72-15॥

translations.english: "You have earned me a great religious merit. I shall be always your disciple O Eminent ascestics, occupy these important seats".

verses.sloka: यथा दशरथस्य इयम् तथा अयोध्या पुरी मम ।प्रभुत्वे न अस्ति सन्देहो यथा अर्हम् कर्तुम् अर्हथः ॥१-७२-१६॥
verses.transliteration: yathā daśarathasya iyam tathā ayodhyā purī mama ।prabhutve na asti sandeho yathā arham kartum arhathaḥ ॥1-72-16॥

translations.english: "Dasaratha has right on the city of Ayodhya as much as I have on this. This right is unquestionable. So do whatever you think right".
translations.hindi: धनुष के टूटने के विकराल शाब्द के होने पर विश्वामित्र, राजा जनक और दोनों राजकुमारों को छोड़, सब लोग मूच्छित हो गिर पड़े

verses.sloka: तथा ब्रुवति वैदेहे जनके रघु नंदनः ।राजा दशरथो हृष्टः प्रत्युवाच मही पतिम् ॥१-७२-१७॥
verses.transliteration: tathā bruvati vaidehe janake raghu naṁdanaḥ ।rājā daśaratho hṛṣṭaḥ pratyuvāca mahī patim ॥1-72-17॥

translations.english: To the words of Janaka, king of Videha, king Dasaratha, the descendant of Raghu cheerfully replied:
translations.hindi: महायशास्त्री पुरुषोत्तम एवं बलवान्‌ श्रीराम ने रोदा चढ़ाने कें बाद ज्यों ही रोदे को खींचा, त्यों ही वह धनुष बीच से टूट गया अर्थात्‌ उस धनुष के दो डुकडे हो गए

verses.sloka: युवाम् असंख्येय गुणौ भ्रातरौ मिथिलेश्वरौ ।ऋषयो राज संघाः च भवद्भ्याम् अभिपूजिताः ॥१-७२-१८॥
verses.transliteration: yuvām asaṁkhyeya guṇau bhrātarau mithileśvarau ।ṛṣayo rāja saṁghāḥ ca bhavadbhyām abhipūjitāḥ ॥1-72-18॥

translations.english: "You both brothers are lords of Mithila. You possess countless virtues. You pay regards to many rishis and hosts of kings".

verses.sloka: स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि भद्रम् ते गमिष्यामः स्वम् आलयम् ।श्राद्ध कर्माणि विधिवत् विधास्य इति च अब्रवीत् ॥१-७२-१९॥
verses.transliteration: svasti prāpnuhi bhadram te gamiṣyāmaḥ svam ālayam ।śrāddha karmāṇi vidhivat vidhāsya iti ca abravīt ॥1-72-19॥

translations.english: "Be safe. Be blessed. Let me retire to the camp. I have to perform the rites offerings to the forefathers".

verses.sloka: तम् आपृष्ट्वा नर पतिम् राजा दशरथः तदा ।मुनीन्द्रौ तौ पुरस्कृत्य जगाम आशु महायशाः ॥१-७२-२०॥
verses.transliteration: tam āpṛṣṭvā nara patim rājā daśarathaḥ tadā ।munīndrau tau puraskṛtya jagāma āśu mahāyaśāḥ ॥1-72-20॥

translations.english: Then renowned king Dasaratha, took leave of the two great ascetics. Then the rowned king Dasaratha took have of the king (Janaka) immediately following the two great ascetics.
translations.hindi: सब लोगों की मूछो भङ्ग हुई, वे सचेत हुए तथा राजा जनक के सब सन्देह दूर हो गए । तब राजा जनक हाथ जोड़, चतुर विश्वामित्र से कहने लगे

verses.sloka: स गत्वा निलयम् राजा श्राद्धम् कृत्वा विधानतः ।प्रभाते काल्यम् उत्थाय चक्रे गो दानम् उत्तमम् ॥१-७२-२१॥
verses.transliteration: sa gatvā nilayam rājā śrāddham kṛtvā vidhānataḥ ।prabhāte kālyam utthāya cakre go dānam uttamam ॥1-72-21॥

translations.english: The king (Dasaratha) reached the abode, performed the sharaddha ceremony in accordance with the scriptures. Next day at dawn at appropriate time he gifted away cows (a ceremony performed by initiating the bridegrooms into the marriage.)
translations.hindi: हे भगवन्‌ ! महाराज दशरथ जी के पुत्र श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का यह अत्यन्त विस्मयोत्पादक, अचिन्त्य और अतर्कित ( जिसमें सन्देह करने को कोई गुज्ञाइश न हो ) पराक्रम मैंने देखा

verses.sloka: गवाम् शत सहस्रम् च ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नराधिपः ।एक एकशो ददौ राजा पुत्रान् उद्धिश्य धर्मतः ॥१-७२-२२॥
verses.transliteration: gavām śata sahasram ca brāhmaṇebhyo narādhipaḥ ।eka ekaśo dadau rājā putrān uddhiśya dharmataḥ ॥1-72-22॥

translations.english: For the welfare of each of his sons the king (Dasaratha) religiously gave away a hundred thousand cows to brahmins.

verses.sloka: सुवर्ण शृंगयः संपन्नाः स वत्साः काम्स्य दोहनाः ।गवाम् शत सहस्राणि चत्वारि पुरुष ऋषभः ॥१-७२-२३॥
verses.transliteration: suvarṇa śṛṁgayaḥ saṁpannāḥ sa vatsāḥ kāmsya dohanāḥ ।gavām śata sahasrāṇi catvāri puruṣa ṛṣabhaḥ ॥1-72-23॥

translations.english: Great among men and affectionate towards his children, (king Dasaratha), the delight of the Raghus donated in the name of his sons' donates to the brahmins four hundred thousand cows. They were capable of abundance of milk. Their horns were plaited with gold. They were accompanied by calves. With them were given away bellmetal vessels for keeping milk and innumerable valuables.
translations.hindi: हे कौशिक ! मैंने सीता के विवाह के लिए “वीर्येशुल्क” की जो प्रतिज्ञा की थी वह आज पूरी हो गई । आज मैं अपनी प्राणों से भी बढ़ कर प्यारी सीता श्रीराम को.दूँगा

verses.sloka: वित्तम् अन्यत् च सु बहु द्विजेभ्यो रघु नंदनः ।ददौ गो दानम् उद्दिश्य पुत्राणाम् पुत्र वत्सलः ॥१-७२-२४॥
verses.transliteration: vittam anyat ca su bahu dvijebhyo raghu naṁdanaḥ ।dadau go dānam uddiśya putrāṇām putra vatsalaḥ ॥1-72-24॥

translations.english: Great among men and affectionate towards his children, (king Dasaratha), the delight of the Raghus donated in the name of his sons' donates to the brahmins four hundred thousand cows. They were capable of abundance of milk. Their horns were plaited with gold. They were accompanied by calves. With them were given away bellmetal vessels for keeping milk and innumerable valuables.
translations.hindi: हे ब्रह्म्‌! हे कौशिक ! यदि आपकी सम्मति हो तो मेरे मंत्री, रथ पर सवार हो, शीघ्र अयोध्या को जाँय

verses.sloka: स सुतैः कृत गो दानैः वृतः सः नृपतिः तदा ।लोक पालैः इव आभाति वृतः सौम्यः प्रजापतिः ॥१-७२-२५॥
verses.transliteration: sa sutaiḥ kṛta go dānaiḥ vṛtaḥ saḥ nṛpatiḥ tadā ।loka pālaiḥ iva ābhāti vṛtaḥ saumyaḥ prajāpatiḥ ॥1-72-25॥

translations.english: With his sons for whose sake cows have been given away the cheerful king looked like shining Prajapati surrrounded by the guardians of the world. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे द्विसप्ततितमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the seventhsecond sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
